rationale: firebase-tools carries no advisory of its own; its high severity comes from bundled tar (see the tar entry below) plus a transitive uuid finding. It is a devDependency used only to run local emulators and to deploy from a developer or release machine; it never ships in a deployed artifact. Pinned to ^14.11.1 and already at 14.27.0, the newest 14.x release. The fix is firebase-tools@15.28.1, a major upgrade. Scheduling that upgrade and its migration notes separately.

tar is a transitive devDependency pulled in by firebase-tools, only used to unpack CLI/emulator archives on a developer or release machine; it is never a runtime dependency of a deployed function or the web app. The fix requires the same firebase-tools@15.28.1 major upgrade tracked above. Scheduling together with that migration.
